class.name: PhysXRuntimeManager
class.brief_description: Detects missing PhysX runtime binaries next to the editor executable and supports the runtime download-and-restart flow. Editor-only.
class.description:
The PhysX module ships its GPU runtime (PhysXGpu) and Blast destruction DLLs separately from the editor. When a project selects the PhysX physics engine, these files must sit next to the editor executable; the editor detects their absence and offers to download the bundle published in the redot-physx-runtime repository.
PhysXRuntimeManager exposes the checks and install helpers behind that flow to scripts: the required-file list per platform, the missing-file query, bundle manifest parsing, bundle extraction with per-file SHA-256 verification, and a fallback installer stub. It is registered at editor initialization level, so it exists only in the editor, not in running games.

method.name: extract_bundle
method.description: Extracts the manifest-listed files from the bundle zip at [param zip_path] into [param target_dir], verifying each file's SHA-256 (from [param bundle] [code]files[].sha256[/code]) as it is written. On a mismatch or read failure, the offending file is removed and every file written by this call is rolled back, leaving no half-updated mix of binaries. Returns an [enum Error] code.

method.name: get_missing_runtime_files
method.description: Returns the names of the required runtime files that are not present in the executable's directory (e.g. [code]PhysXGpu_64.dll[/code] and the Blast DLLs on Windows, [code]libPhysXGpu_64.so[/code] on Linux).

method.name: get_required_runtime_files
method.description: Returns the runtime file names that must sit next to the editor executable for PhysX and Blast to work, for the current platform.

method.name: install_missing_files
method.description: Currently a placeholder: the runtime install is driven by the editor plugin's download-and-restart flow instead. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE].

method.name: is_runtime_complete
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when every required runtime file is present in the executable's directory.

method.name: parse_manifest
method.description: Parses runtime manifest JSON and returns the current platform's bundle dictionary ([code]url[/code], [code]sha256[/code], [code]size_bytes[/code], [code]files[/code]) — an empty [Dictionary] when the manifest is malformed, or when it has no bundle for the running platform.

method.name: sha256_file
method.description: Returns the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 checksum of the file at [param path], or an empty [String] if the file cannot be read.
